description: Sightkick writes a page (research, outline, draft, judge, revise, images) from the plan's monthly pages, and is refused when none are left (get_workspace plan): then you write it with update_page. Give an unwritten page's articleId, or a title and primaryKeyword for a new one. It takes minutes and returns at once: poll get_pages page. It keeps its slot. A page about a rival is written only with real evidence.
name: generate_page
title: Have Sightkick write a page
